description: Camera scan in your browser: emotions, stress, composure, eye contact, micro-expressions and a heart-rate estimate. Play the deception challenge with a friend, read any video, or run a before-and-after check around a workout. The scan itself runs on-device and no video or audio leaves the device. Entertainment and self-insight, not a medical or lie-detection tool. Powered by EmoPulse.
author: emopulse
